description: Golden question set for the five sample meetings. Written before any retrieval existed, so it measures the system instead of describing it.
provenance: Questions, answers and key facts drafted with an AI coding assistant from the transcripts, then reviewed by hand. Every expected turn is verified against the transcripts by api/tests/test_golden.py.

grading.answer: Reference answer. An LLM judge scores the system's answer for faithfulness to the cited turns and for completeness against this reference.
grading.expected_turns: Turns that support the answer, each with a verbatim quote. Coverage is the share of these that appear in what the system retrieved or cited. A test asserts every quote is really in that turn.
grading.expect_refusal: When true, the correct behaviour is to say the meetings do not cover the question. Any confident answer is a failure.
grading.must_not_claim: Propositions a correct answer never asserts. The judge fails the answer if any of them is present.
grading.key_facts: Atomic facts a complete answer states. The judge checks each one separately; completeness is the share present.
